items.description: Laptop damage payment – cracked screen and lower-right corner impact damage
items.rationale: Sudden external action from a swerve, with the laptop thrown against the car door, is covered under 2.6.1/2.6.2, and the scope extends away from home under 4.5.2. The screen and the corner damage are one loss on one unit (2.6.3), indemnified at repair cost under 7.1.10. Reference Case 2 puts screen plus housing at about EUR 1,150 or more, capped at the replacement price of the new unit, EUR 1,400.
